name: Brand Studio
intro: Brand Studio turns a website address into a saved Brand DNA, then gives you linked tools for on-brand campaigns, edited assets, product photos and animation.

features.analyze-website-to-brand-dna: Paste your website address into the box and press Analyze. SmartVideo reads the page and builds your Brand DNA, which every other tool here uses.
features.brand-tools-grid: The Brand tools grid has five cards, Brand DNA, Campaigns, Asset Editor, Photo Studio and Animate. Use them to jump straight into whichever step you need.
features.recent-brands: Recent Brands lists the brands you've already analysed, so you can open one again and carry on where you left off.
features.brand-dna-editor: The Brand DNA editor shows your tagline, tone, audience, fonts and colors. Fix anything the AI got wrong, then click Save, because edits only stick after you do.
features.campaign-studio: In Campaign Studio you pick a goal such as Product Launch, get four on-brand concepts, then choose platforms for matching creatives with ready-made copy.
features.asset-editor: The Asset Editor lets you place a headline, body text and call to action on your picture. Adjust position, size, color and font to finish the creative.
features.photo-studio: Photo Studio takes one product photo and offers presets across six categories, from beauty to tech. Choose a resolution, select styles, and get many product visuals from a single upload.

outro: With your Brand DNA saved, every campaign and photo starts on brand. Analyze your homepage first, and the rest of Brand Studio falls into place.
